item.title: Crosby Stills Nash & Young show at Tierneys — Fri Oct 2, 8:00 PM — Tierney’s Tavern
item.description:
The Jimmy Cowan Band returns to Tierneys on October 2 to perform their new Crosby Stills Nash & Young show. The Jimmy Cowan Band is known for working hard on their shows for months before performing them. The CSNY show includes many CSNY songs plus songs from the individual members’ solo careers plus some of Joni Mitchell’s most loved songs. The Jimmy Cowan Band has performed some great shows in the past few years such as a Pink Floyd show, The Who, the Rolling Stones, David Bowie, Tom Petty & the Heartbreakers and most recently a very well received Talking Heads show. You know it’s a memorable show when you hear people singing the songs in the parking lot after the show is over. Please join the band as they celebrate the music of David Crosby, Stephen Stills, Graham Nash and Neil Young… hope to see you their! Share this: Share on Facebook (Opens in new window) Facebook

item.title: Switchfoot - Forever Now Tour — Fri Oct 2, 8:00 PM — The Wellmont Theater
item.description: Switchfoot have spent nearly three decades cementing their place as one of the genre’s most enduring and impactful acts. With over 10 million albums sold, including their 3x Platinum breakthrough The Beautiful Letdown and GRAMMY Award-winning Hello Hurricane, the beloved band has built a global following through emotionally resonant songwriting and electrifying live performances, selling more than five million tickets across 40+ countries. With a renewed focus on the present moment, the band delivers their first record in five years, Forever Now – their fourteenth studio album, due June 26. A bold, guitar-driven return to their classic sound, the project serves as their most thematic and narrative-driven work to date, centering on the emotional roller coaster of a person’s final day on Earth. item.title: Hackensack River Cruise: Boating Through Bergen — Thu Oct 8, 1:00 PM — Montclair - Offsite
item.description:
This is a paid Adult School class. Click here to register.
Join us for a trip up the Hackensack River from the southern Meadowlands to heart of the city of Hackensack. Taking the route once traveled by the coastal schooners and steamers that carried cargo to and from Bergen County, we will pass the ruins of their former docks and landings and discuss the region’s all-but-forgotten maritime history. Before turning back, we will travel upriver to the Court Street Bridge and offer participants an opportunity to get an up-close view of the USS Ling, a World War II submarine that was sadly abandoned after Hurricane Sandy in 2012.
Source: Libcal Bccls 10306

item.title: Montclair A Cappella Bake Sale — Mon Oct 12, 2:00 PM — Student Center 2C01 - 2nd Floor Lobby
item.description:
Montclair A Cappella is a vocal group where students are encouraged to show off their talents at a competitive level. We cover all aspects of what is necessary to provide stunning live or recorded performances. As an A Cappella group, we focus on vocal arrangements in order to perform in the ICCA's, BOSS, musical festivals, and more. We also aim to perform at on-campus events and host of few concerts of our own. In order to participate in the vocal group, there is an audition process. However, ALL students are welcome to be involved in making arrangements, choreography, and audio/video production. Montclair A Cappella strives to be a community of music-loving individuals with a drive for professionalism and performance etiquette that stretches beyond the stage lights. Join us for our bake sale! Come out and support us by buying treats!
